subject: Substitution approval requested: a PEX alternate in lieu of the copper domestic water

messages.text: Attached is the cut sheet and third-party listing for a PEX alternate in lieu of the copper domestic water piping specified in Section 22 11 16 -- please confirm it's acceptable. We would like this reviewed before the fixture rough-in gets underway. A response by the end of the day would let us keep the order on track.
